parameters.content:
## New Jersey Business Registry Lookup & Name Checker

**Actor:** [New Jersey Business Registry Lookup & Name Checker](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/new-jersey-business-registry-lookup-and-name)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/new-jersey-business-registry-lookup-and-name-checker.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `businessNames` (array)
- `keywordSearches` (array)
- `entityIds` (array)
- `linkType` (string)
- `linkedName` (string)
- `linkedFirstName` (string)
- `linkedMiddleName` (string)
- `linkedCity` (string)
- `entityTypes` (array)
- `cityFilter` (string)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `businessName` (Business Name)
- `entityId` (Entity Id)
- `entityTypeAbbr` (Entity Type Abbr)
- `entityTypeFull` (Entity Type Full)
- `city` (City)
- `incorporatedDate` (Incorporated Date)
- `incorporatedMonth` (Incorporated Month)
- `isAvailable` (Is Available)
- `documentCount` (Document Count)

description: New Jersey business entity search: runs the New Jersey Business Registry Lookup & Name Checker Apify Actor, returns businessName, entityTypeAbbr, entityTypeFull, city, incorporatedDate and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
